facts.business: Veer Energy & Infrastructure Limited is engaged in wind energy infrastructure development and explores opportunities in the broader renewable energy sector.

auditor.name: M/s. Jayesh R. Shah & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Inventory (Power Evacuation Facilities carried since 2015 at Rs 5.88 crore with impairment provision of Rs 1.75 crore, and land for wind farm project written down from Rs 4.75 crore to Rs 4.51 crore, dependent on successful execution of solar power projects) and Contingent Liabilities (Income Tax demand of Rs 6.92 crore for AY 2018-19 and GST demand of Rs 28.80 lakh for AY 2018-19).

key_risks: Realizability of carrying values of Power Evacuation Facilities and wind farm land dependent on successful identification and execution of solar power projects or asset sale
Uncertain outcome of Income Tax demand of Rs 6.92 crore and GST demand of Rs 28.80 lakh for AY 2018-19
Significant unrealized losses on equity investments measured at FVTOCI due to macroeconomic factors
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. Refer Note 36 to the financial statements for related party disclosures.
